Swamishri during the welcome assembly, with a backdrop of bricks and lamps illuminating the stage. 2 Dec 99

w: In the presence of Pramukh Swami Maharaj, Shri L. K. Advani, the Home Minister of India, inaugurated the English Medium Residential School for Girls established by Swaminarayan Vidyapith. The state-of-the-art school, inspired by Pramukh Swami Maharaj, will acomoodate 700 girls. ( see special report )

After Swamishri's morning puja, the Department of Health, Gujarat Government, had organized a camp to prevent child paralysis. Swamishri was requested to launch the camp in Kheda district by the local officials. Prior to this the officials informed the congregation about the scourge of paralysis in children. Thereafter Swamishri administered the medicine into the mouths of five children and the program was continued thereafter by senior sadhus.

"Bapa! You forgot my name during the morning discourse. Instead of Harshad you called me Rasik," Harshadbhai stated. "Both names are the same! Are you Brahm or not?", Swamishri posed. "Yes." "Then whatever name you call Brahm by will do. So why are you upset! Whenever something like this happens apply 'gnan' (knowledge). Whatever that is said, whatever name you are called by or if you are told off, then always remain happy. Was it not that in some past birth you had Rasik as your name!" Swamishri's words awakened all with the true knowledge and nature of one's real self.

At 10.10 a.m. Swamishri arrived in Ghodasar and performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of a new BAPS Hari mandir. On the previous day 585 devotees participated in the yagna and from 4.00 p.m. After blessing the murti-pratishtha assembly Swamishri visited the derelict house of Jalamsinh Bapu that was sanctified by Bhagwan Swaminarayan 193 years ago. Swamishri blessed the seventh generation of Jalamsinh Bapu - Shri Ghanshyamsinh and his family. Thereafter Swamishri went to the 250 year old Vaishnav Haveli in Ghodasar and did darshan of Shri Bal Krishna (murti of Lalji).
Swamishri arrived in Mahemdavad at 1.15 p.m. After lunch Swamishri blessed the devotees.

At 5.50 p.m. Swamishri arrived at the Swaminarayan Sanskardham (Hari mandir) in Krishnanagar (a suburb of Amdavad) and performed pujan and arti of the deities. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the assembly and went to a hospital to bless the ailing Pujya Devcharan Swami.
At 7.35 p.m. Swamishri arrived in Gandhinagar and blessed the satsang assembly.
Swamishri performed the murti-pujan rituals of murtis for BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir (hari mandir) for Khanpur village.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
Swamishri blessed the devotees of Demi and Napad villages who observed a waterless fast for 84 hours.
About eighty devotees pilgrimaged by foot from Atladra to Bochasan.

Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis for BAPS hari mandirs in Pipalav, Verakhadi and Boriya. He also performed the re- pratishtha rituals of the murtis of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj for the hari mandir in Jitodiya.
